name: The Cup Runneth Over raises Bloodmoon Blast's spell power scaling (#3680)
contract: The Cup Runneth Over 807544: "Increases the spell power scaling of Bloodmoon Blast, Taldaram's Torment and Bloodbolt by $s1%." Effect 0 is aura 108 SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER (op 24) +20 on family 26 mask (0, 0x22000, 0) = Bloodmoon Blast (0x2000) and Bloodbolt (0x20000). Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone only applies SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER when the spell has a nonzero coefficient, and Bloodmoon Blast 500125 has EffectBonusMultiplier 0.0 and no spell_bonus_data row on its chain head, although its description states $sps*0.466229. So Bloodmoon Blast ignores spell power and the talent multiplies nothing. The probe is spell_damage_done on rank 10 572332 (SpellLevel 68, base 1000; rank 1 SpellLevel 1 / MaxLevel 4 leaves a level 80 caster 2.5% of the coefficient through CalculateLevelPenalty) with and without Increase Spell Dam 42062 (+259 spell power), then with the talent. PREREQUISITE and DISCRIMINATING both fail on current main. Effect 1 (op 40, Taldaram's Torment, whose description states no spell power term) is not asserted.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
